title: Email signature / installation and formatting
slide_intent: Make an everyday identity repeatable across software so names, contact details and brand cues survive implementation.
strategic_value: Platform-specific instructions can reduce broken or inconsistent DB signatures.
demonstration: Five expanded instruction groups cover Outlook, mobile setup, sleeper placement, typography and Teams links, with signature examples in the mobile group.
practical_value: Start with the provided template, check the target email client and send a test before relying on the result.

content_islands.name: Outlook setup
content_islands.spec: Sequence the six desktop steps and caveats at the top.

content_islands.name: Mobile setup
content_islands.spec: Follow with separate device instructions and before/after signature illustrations.

content_islands.name: Sleeper and type
content_islands.spec: Explain PNG placement between personal and contact information, then the 11 pt Aptos default and optional name emphasis.

content_islands.name: Teams links
content_islands.spec: Finish with chat/call links below contact details and their spacing instruction.

reference_purposes.Intent: The text explains preserving the sleeper-to-text relationship and making the sender name visible.
reference_purposes.Application: The expanded instructions describe setup, inserting assets, testing and adding Teams contact links.
reference_purposes.Constraint: The sleeper PNG is not resized after insertion; the source notes mobile embedding remains unreliable and prescribes a blank line above Teams links.

ingredient.name: Email signature construction
ingredient.role: Keep sender identification, contact details and brand accent consistent.
ingredient.application: Place the supplied sleeper PNG between personal and contact blocks without subsequent resizing; the shown default is Aptos 11 pt, with optional bold name one point larger.
ingredient.scope: These are source-specific email instructions. Mobile embedding is explicitly described as unreliable; generic graphic-resizing advice elsewhere does not override the sleeper restriction.
